top20Sample.product: Peek-CLI: let coding agents see your browser
top20Sample.reason: 把浏览器状态暴露给 coding agent，值得看它能否降低调试网页时反复截图和人工描述的摩擦。

top20Sample.product: Adrafinil – keep a lid-closed Mac awake only while agents work
top20Sample.reason: 这是很窄的 agent 基础设施痛点：让本地长任务不断电，适合观察 AI 工具是否会催生系统级小工具。

top20Sample.product: A REPL for browsers that agents love
top20Sample.reason: 浏览器 REPL 直接服务 agent 操作网页，关键看它比现有 DevTools/Playwright 多出的控制闭环是否足够清晰。

top20Sample.product: AgentWatch – Prevent runaway AI agents with runtime budget enforcement
top20Sample.reason: 把 runaway agent 变成预算和运行时治理问题，适合看企业 agent 产品如何把风险控制做成购买理由。

top20Sample.product: Git-temp – scratchpad folder for AI agents; doesn't clutter Git status
top20Sample.reason: 解决 agent 临时文件污染 Git 状态的小问题，启发点在于把 AI 编程协作里的“脏工作区”产品化。

top20Sample.product: Better Graphs – Teach agents to stop making plain Matplotlib slop
top20Sample.reason: 它把 agent 输出质量问题落到图表审美和默认模板，值得看是否能从提示词经验沉淀成可复用规范。

top20Sample.product: Making a label printer work under Linux using agentic AI
